summary.text: Johnny Baucom is the Libertarian candidate for Mississippi's 1st District. He describes himself as a Mississippian raised by a single mother who earned a GED through the National Guard Youth Challenge Program, served in the Army National Guard from 2014 to 2020, and later managed mechanic shops. Ballotpedia lists his profession as environmental specialist.

paragraphs.text: Baucom says he was raised in poverty by a single mother and left high school after ninth grade. He says he earned his GED through the National Guard Youth Challenge Program at Camp Shelby in Hattiesburg.

He served in the U.S. Army National Guard from 2014 to 2020 on a six-year contract, according to his Ballotpedia survey, and says he used skills from the military to manage multiple mechanic shops afterward.
The Mississippi Free Press describes him as an Army National Guard veteran who works as an environmental specialist.

sources.title: Meet the Candidates for Mississippi's 1st Congressional District in the Nov. 3 Elections
